Controls

Mouse — drag = orbit (Free/Follow) · wheel = zoom (zoom-to-cursor in Free) · shift/right-drag = pan (Free) · drag the timeline to scrub.

Cameras

1 Free orbit · 2 Follow (centre on rocket) · 3 Chase (ride behind the flight path) · 4 Onboard (nose FPV) · 5 reset camera. f toggles Follow.

Transport

Space play/pause · ←/→ step frame (Shift = x10) · Home/End first/last · r restart · [ ] speed · +/- zoom.

Layers

g grid · t trail · e EKF belief · h HUD · m minimap. Chips in the panel toggle every overlay.

Legend

Trail coloured by phase (BOOST orange, COAST blue, BURN red, TD green). Gray = EKF belief. Green ring = target. Amber arrow = velocity vector.

Press ? or Esc to close.

Each cell/slider position is a full run of the EXACT firmware.
